map.→ 打开由数值序列求算术平均数工具: -> Open the arithmetic mean from a numeric sequence tool
map.为什么均值会被极端值影响？: Why is the mean affected by extreme values?
map.均值把每个数平等相加再除以个数，一个极大或极小的数会拉高或拉低总和，从而改变结果: The mean adds every number equally and divides by the count, so one very large or very small number raises or lowers the total and changes the result; the median only cares about position, so it is unaffected by how extreme the values at either end are.
map.对比两组数据的平均水平时先算均值再比较: When comparing the average level of two sets of data, compute the mean first and then compare
map.平均数、中位数、众数有什么区别？: What is the difference between the mean, median and mode?
map.平均数是所有数之和除以个数，受极端值影响大；中位数是排序后居中那个数，对离群点稳: The mean is the sum of all values divided by the count and is strongly affected by extremes; the median is the middle value after sorting and is robust to outliers; the mode is the value that appears most often. With a skewed distribution the three diverge clearly, so pick by scenario.

map.输入一组以逗号或空格分隔的数值，计算其算术平均数 x̄ = Σx/n，用于统计平: Enter a set of values separated by commas or spaces to compute the arithmetic mean x-bar = sum(x)/n, for quickly solving statistical averages.
map.输入多个数值（逗号或空格分隔），求算术平均数。: Enter several values (comma or space separated) to find the arithmetic mean.
map.：数据 80, 90, 70, 100 的算术平均 = (80+90+70+10: : the arithmetic mean of 80, 90, 70 and 100 is (80+90+70+100) / 4 = 340 / 4 = 85. Note that extremes pull the mean up or down, so when outliers are present look at the median as well.
map.：若三次测验权重分别为 0.2/0.3/0.5，成绩 80/90/70，则加权平: : if three test weights are 0.2, 0.3 and 0.5 with scores of 80, 90 and 70, the weighted mean = 80x0.2 + 90x0.3 + 70x0.5 = 16 + 27 + 35 = 78, which puts more emphasis on the heavily weighted sitting than a simple average.
